author: Production Data Safety Gate
description: Canonical allowlist of approved exceptions for the Production Data Safety Gate static analysis.

exceptions.justification: Admin tool gated by nonce + manage_settings capability + JS confirm(). Cannot be triggered by accident.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin tool that clears _transient_ecb_* options. Gated by nonce + capability. Only affects cache transients.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: User-initiated action: deleting the OpenAI API key from the IA Context settings form. Gated by nonce + capability.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin analytics deletion handler. Gated by nonce + manage_settings. Scoped by conversation_id or session_key+channel.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin conversation deletion handler. Gated by nonce + manage_settings. Scoped by ID or full table wipe (JS confirm).
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin lead deletion handler. Gated by nonce + manage_settings. Scoped by ID.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin log deletion and retention cleanup. Scoped by datetime threshold or ID. Gated by nonce.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Cleanup during product template sync. Deletes metadata for a specific post by ID. Scoped, not bulk.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Runs only on plugin activation. array_merge preserves existing values (defaults are second param).
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin export/delete handler. Gated by nonce + capability. Only deletes selected entry IDs.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Migration cleanup: removes a one-time migration flag after execution. Runs once per install.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin bulk/individual lead deletion. Gated by nonce + manage_options + JS confirm(). Scoped by lead_id IN (...).
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin customer deletion. Gated by nonce + capability. Scoped by customer IDs.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Removes an obsolete/completed schema migration option. Gated by schema version check.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Removes duplicate customer rows during migration (self-JOIN dedup). Runs once per schema version upgrade.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Scoped deletion of expired lock/transient rows from wp_options by option_name + option_value match.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Comment in code referencing migration pattern, not an actual SQL execution at runtime.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin-initiated cleanup of resolved telemetry records. Gated by nonce + manage_options. Only deletes WHERE resolved=1.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin action to delete a single resolved telemetry entry. Gated by nonce + manage_options.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Admin project deletion handler. Gated by nonce + manage_options. Scoped by project ID.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Uninstall cleanup: drops estandar_secure_deliveries table. Only called from uninstall() method gated by WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN constant and delete_on_uninstall option.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Uninstall cleanup: drops estandar_secure_audit_log table. Only called from uninstall() gated by WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN constant and delete_on_uninstall option.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Uninstall cleanup: drops estandar_secure_requests table. Only called from uninstall() gated by WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN constant and delete_on_uninstall option.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Uninstall cleanup: deletes estandar_secure_share_settings option. Gated by WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN constant and delete_on_uninstall option.
exceptions.author: safety-gate-review

exceptions.justification: Uninstall cleanup: deletes estandar_secure_share_templates option. Gated by WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN constant and delete_on_uninstall option.

exceptions.justification: Registers the uninstall callback that cleans up tables and options on plugin deletion. Standard WordPress pattern.
